## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Lóngshī púsà běnqǐ jīng* (T558) is a one-fascicle Mahāyāna sūtra by Dharmarakṣa 竺法護 ([竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7)), parallel to [KR6i0189](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0189) (T557) by Zhī Qiān. *Běnqǐ* 本起 indicates a text on the bodhisattva's original aspiration / *bodhicittotpāda*.

**Abstract**

This is a parallel translation of the Nāga-girl narrative ([KR6i0189](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0189)). Dharmarakṣa's longer title makes explicit the text's focus on the bodhisattva's *běnqǐ* (origin / arising of bodhicitta). Translation dated to Dharmarakṣa's productive period (266–308 CE).
